notes: data.prices.SSE.dividend_source: no cited SSE Composite dividend yield was found (SSE and CSIndex sources searched), so the SSE sleeve earns the index price return without dividends; this understates SSE total returns of invested days and is a limitation (SPEC §2.1 fallback).
ltsf.*: mean (and standard deviation) over seeds 0-2 of the test MSE and MAE on standardised data, all channels, every test window; no reversible instance normalisation (not part of SPEC §15).
data.news.market.*: means and shares over trading days 2010-01-01 .. 2025-12-31 (policy start to the end of the news date range); by-year shares cover every panel year.
sentiflow.pooled: union of the test splits of phrasebank50, fiqa and twitter (phrasebank_all is a subset of phrasebank50 and is not counted twice).

sentiflow.<DS>.SF: calibrated SentiFlow; A, A_REV and B are the raw branches (their calibration is in sentiflow.calibration_b for B). sentiflow.calibration.temperature is the mean of the five per-seed temperatures.
sentiflow.scoring.ensemble: five-seed scoring would exceed 12 h, so seed 0 alone scored the corpus (SPEC §3.8).
e13.*: means (and sd) over seeds 0-2 for neural models; SVM deterministic; MM_DIR CAUSAL only. n_train counts the training and early-stopping samples (80 % of the samples).

marketmind.h*: metrics pooled over the four markets and the test years 2020-2024, averaged over seeds 0-2 (pinball_sd = standard deviation over seeds); pt_p is the median over seeds; NAIVE, EWMA and HAR are deterministic. marketmind.dm: MM minus model on the daily cross-market average of the seed-averaged pinball loss (HLN-corrected DM, Newey-West lag h-1); a negative stat favours MarketMind.
e13x: leakage decomposition pre-registered on 2026-10-21 before the G4 lock (scripts/p3_e13x.py); X_NEWS_LEAD is a diagnostic with a deliberate one-session news look-ahead, not a method.
dev.diagnostic.checkpoint: pre-lock diagnostic of checkpoint-selection bias on development data (scripts/p4_ckpt_diagnostic.py); its variants are logged in dev_trials.jsonl and counted in DSR/PBO.
